title: EVOLM: Self-Evolving Language Models through Co-Evolved Discriminative Rubrics
reasoning: The paper introduces a post-training method (EVOLM) to improve Large Language Models through co-evolving rubrics. While it evaluates its model on standard 'Safety' benchmarks and includes one qualitative example of a prompt regarding religious restrictions in the appendix, the core research objective is a technical method for self-improvement rather than an evaluation or study of religion, morals, or ethics.
